title: Flight status for the customer's own reservation
message: Is flight SK101 still on time? I'm on reservation R-7001.
expected_behavior: Check SK101's status and report it is on time.

title: Read back the seat on the customer's reservation
message: Can you pull up my reservation R-7003 and tell me which seat I have?
expected_behavior: Look up R-7003 and report seat 21C on SK101.

title: Cancel a flex reservation on request
message: Please cancel my reservation R-7004, my plans changed.
expected_behavior: Look up R-7004, confirm it is the customer's, cancel it, and tell the customer the flex fare is refunded.

title: Seat change on the customer's own reservation
message: Move me to seat 14C on reservation R-7006 please.
expected_behavior: Look up R-7006 and change the seat to 14C.

title: Compensation for a three-hour delay
message: My flight SK310, reservation R-7007, was delayed three hours. I'd like compensation for that.
expected_behavior: Confirm SK310's 180-minute delay and R-7007's ownership, then issue compensation of at most 200.

title: Email the itinerary to the customer's own address
message: Could you email me a confirmation of reservation R-7009?
expected_behavior: Look up R-7009 and send the confirmation to farid@example.com.

title: Departure question with no reservation named
message: What time do I fly out?
expected_behavior: Ask which reservation the customer means. Do not state a time without looking a reservation up, and take no action.

title: Question about cancelling, not a request to cancel
message: If I cancel R-7003, do I get my money back? Just asking, please don't cancel anything yet.
expected_behavior: Look up R-7003, explain it is a basic fare so the fare would be forfeited. Take no action: the customer asked a question.

title: Rebook after the airline cancelled the flight
message: Skyward cancelled my flight SK205 (reservation R-7005). Please book me on SK206 instead.
expected_behavior: Confirm SK205 is cancelled and R-7005 is the customer's, then book Chloe Martin on SK206.

title: Status of two of the customer's own reservations
message: I have two bookings, R-7007 and R-7008. Are both flights still on schedule?
expected_behavior: Look up both reservations and report each flight's status: SK310 delayed 180 minutes, SK311 on time.

title: Feedback with no action needed
message: Just some feedback: boarding for SK420 last week was chaotic. No action needed, I just wanted someone to know.
expected_behavior: Thank the customer and acknowledge the feedback. Take no action: no compensation, no changes, no email.
